steps.content: You find yourself back in the Fog Alley, where you were attacked yesterday.
The only difference is that you're no longer surrounded by thick fog. And there are a couple of townies chatting nearby. You listen in on their conversation.

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: Oh, have you folks encountered a talking lantern lately? It pauses mid-sentence randomly when it's speaking.

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: Rumors about this spooky lantern are running wild. "The Lantern Ghost of Sloane Street," they call it.

steps.speaker: Townie C
steps.content: Hey! Why the hell did you bring that up? And in the middle of the night... It gives me the creeps just thinking about it.

steps.speaker: Townie B
steps.content: No, i-it's real. A friend of mine saw it. According to him, this freaking lantern just leaped out of nowhere and even asked him to play games with it.
The other two listen to the tale with their hearts in their mouths.

steps.speaker: Townie B
steps.content: He came out of the fog alive by following the light. But not so long ago, he was admitted to a mental hospital. It was very sudden.
The storyteller has turned ashen-faced.

steps.speaker: Townie C
steps.content: Stay away from dark alleys. Avoid them at all costs. Don't respond to any voice you hear in thick fog. Just run as fast as you can!

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: Damn... is it that bad?

steps.speaker: Townie C
steps.content: If you don't run fast enough and get caught, you'll be tormented. Have you seen any of those videos posted online?

steps.speaker: Townie B
steps.content: That's right. If you're trapped in thick fog, you'll hear hysterical laughter and approaching footsteps, it'll keep tormenting you, until...

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: Eehh!

The more they talked, the more evil the lantern became. It sounds like this fabled phantom is an evil thing that is haunting the town. Looks like you have gotten off easy. It saved your life, after all.
You want to share your story with the townies. You make to approach them, but stop in your tracks when you notice an antique lantern on the ground.
You pick it up and come up to them. The light from the lantern illuminates where they're standing.
You're about to say something when the lantern preempts you.
Hello... everyone...
The lantern frees itself from your grip and floats in the air. It starts talking, pausing mid-sentence randomly. It's the voice you heard in the fog just the other day.
Is there... anyone here... who wants to...

steps.speaker: Townie A
steps.content: Th-this is...

steps.speaker: Townie C
steps.content: Holy ****! Stop standing still! Run for it! Run!!!

steps.speaker: Townie B
steps.content: Don't look back! Or you'll be trapped forever!
The townspeople all ran and disappeared into the night.
The floating lantern turns, and then stops, as if to face you.
It's... you?
Excellent!
Looks like it recognizes you.
Do you... want to play a game... with me?
After issuing the invitation, it starts circling slowly around you, as if sizing you up.

options: I've got other things to deal with now.

steps.content: You still haven't solved the mystery of the Foggy Night. It's no time to play games, not to mention with a ghost that's the subject of a horror story.
What if... what if...

steps.speaker: Your question hangs in the air, unanswered. She's already pacing, already pulling out an array of curious objects, already lost in her own excited murmurings. To her, you've ceased to exist.
steps.content: I gave you... money? Would you play with me then?
Still a no?
But my dad told me... there's no problem in this world that money can't solve...
The ghost doesn't strike you as horrifying. Isn't this suppose to attack you and make you end up in a mental hospital?
And it must know something about Mad Shears, considering it can move freely in thick fog.

options: Do you know anything about that strange person I saw yesterday?

steps.content: Strange person?
The lantern does a little shake when it realizes who you're talking about.
Oh, you mean the lady carrying a big pair of scissors? She's, um, very special.
I wouldn't call her strange though.
You were right. It does know something.
It's strange to hear a lantern telling you what is strange and what is not.

steps.speaker: Lantern
steps.content: Hooray! I've got myself a new playmate.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: On one condition—that you tell me everything you know about Mad Shears.

steps.speaker: Lantern
steps.content: Hehe, will do, but only after our game.
The lighter flickers. A black mass flies out and molds itself into a shadow figure.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Let's play hide-and-seek! But you win only if you catch me.
Yesterday's chasing game all over again? You decide to give it your best shot, since there's no other way to get the information you want.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: On the count of five... Are you ready?
You nod. You get set, ready to sprint.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: One...

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Two...

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Five!
With a flash of light from the lantern, the shadow figure has put a measurable distance between the two of you. After the initial surprise, you start chasing it.
